:::{#rem-irreducible-error}
#### What the irreducible error does and does not depend on

The [irreducible error](#def-irreducible-error) $\varpar$ does not depend on the [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $\fitproc$,
so no choice of prediction can remove it.
It is defined at the single covariate value $\predvar$,
so it may differ from one covariate value to another:
it does not assume constant noise variance across covariate values.
For example, in @exr-epe-three-sources, $\varpar = 3$,
so every prediction there has expected squared prediction error at least $3$.

:::
